profileLabel: Center-left economics; restrictive-leaning on speech and access bills; mixed-to-weak on elections
summary: Pangasinan 3rd District representative with 17 principal-authored bills on health, climate liability, carbon pricing, foreign-influence regulation and a social-media ban for under-13s. She also filed a bill postponing the November 2026 barangay and SK elections to 2028 and co-authored a disinformation penalty bill and a bank-secrecy transparency bill.
caveat: The postponement bill is a filing, not a vote; delayed local elections have precedent and may be logistical. Civil-liberties score rests on regulatory bills with child-safety or security rationales.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Front-of-pack warnings and child-marketing limits (-2); climate loss-and-damage with corporate liability (-3); land redistribution to farmers (-3); PERA increase (-2); carbon pricing as a market tool (0). Mostly regulatory and redistributive.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00130, HB06889, HB06890, HB00127, HB00128 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored foreign-influence regulation (HB01068) and a ban on under-13 independent social-media access (HB09971); co-authored a disinformation penalty bill (HB09465). Child-safety and security rationales exist, but access, speech and privacy proportionality are open questions.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01068, HB09971; co-author HB09465 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Power-concentrating tendency
democratic.rationale: Authored postponing the 2026 barangay and SK elections to 2028 (-3, electoral competition); co-authored bank-secrecy transparency reform (+2). Two issues, thin evidence.
